# Documentation Standards

## Code Documentation
- Use Doxygen-style comments for public APIs
- Document function parameters and return values
- Explain complex algorithms and hardware interactions
- Include pin diagrams and wiring information

## Project Documentation
- Maintain clear README with setup instructions
- Document hardware requirements and connections
- Include build and upload instructions
- Provide troubleshooting guide for common issues

## API Documentation
- Document all public classes and methods
- Include usage examples for key functionality
- Explain configuration options and their effects
- Document hardware-specific considerations

## Hardware Documentation
- Create pin assignment diagrams
- Document electrical specifications and limits
- Include component datasheets and references
- Explain calibration and tuning procedures

## Format Standards
- Use Markdown for most documentation
- Include code examples with syntax highlighting
- Use consistent heading structure
- Add diagrams and images where helpful

## Maintenance
- Keep documentation synchronized with code changes
- Update version information and changelogs
- Review documentation during code reviews
- Validate examples and instructions regularly
